summary: Gold Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing its acquisition of an additional 0.1875% indirect NSR royalty on the REN project for $6.25 million cash, increasing its total indirect NSR to 1.6875% plus a 3.5% Net Profit Interest. The REN project, a development-stage Nevada gold asset owned by Barrick (61.5%) and Newmont (38.5%), is expected to begin production in 2026 and ramp to full output by year-end 2027 at ~140,000 oz/year. No board recommendation or advisor was named. This bolt-on royalty acquisition expands Gold Royalty's existing position on a near-term producer without changing its capital structure. Watch for production milestones from Barrick and potential further consolidation in Gold Royalty's portfolio.
